kind: Bounded CPU and returned numeric-payload measurement, not FPS or heap profiling

protocol.description: Real N16 steel geometry and gravity0 forcejeo fixture from weapon-friction. Canonical current prepared q/v/contacts are copied identically into historical rig; each sample resets those public mechanical inputs outside timing. One warmup per path then five alternating paired samples. No solver or physical output was changed; wrapper only records returned trial references and application count. Output hash identical across all five repeats for each path.
protocol.timing: process.cpuUsage user+system milliseconds; performance.now wall milliseconds around one resolveWeaponBind call only. Includes lightweight wrapper push/increment, excludes result counting and diagnostic energy reads. Small-sample CPU granularity and JIT/GC variance are exposed, not hidden.
protocol.payload: Number of numeric values returned by all trials multiplied by8, including nested constraint rows. Logical binary64 payload lower bound, NOT heap/RSS/allocator bytes. Excludes objects, strings, array headers, maps, temporaries and internal solver allocations. Captured trial references retained until accounting after timing.
protocol.abortedHarness: Initial instrumentation setup attempted .set on previousQ before baseline construction had that optional field. Aborted before any measured resolveWeaponBind sample; corrected memory reset to copy own snapshot values. No runtime/test writes.

baselineLimit: Exact archived4c4ba rig is imported as a private data module with relative imports relocated. Current weapon-bind detects absent trial and takes its unchanged legacy contactInertia/frictionResponse/apply path (plus dispatch). project:false prevents current ArticulatedRig.projectContact private-class mismatch. Compares historical physical algorithm against signed-total algorithm on identical inputs, NOT equal outputs or full-game baseline. No archived weapon-bind byte identity claimed.

interpretation.cpuMeasurement: Unavailable at this per-call scale: process.cpuUsage reports0 for most samples and16/31/63ms jumps. These process-wide quantized numbers must not be interpreted as per-call CPU service time. Retained raw for transparency. No extra repetitions performed.
interpretation.wallMeasurement: Synchronous CPU-only Node wall duration, not browser FPS: current medians1.161–2.315ms; legacy comparison medians0.431–0.544ms across4fixtures. Five samples and one warmup expose substantial JIT/GC variance; ratios describe this bounded run only.
interpretation.payloadMeasurement: 8–10 total trials per call: 2*iterations plus2 final-validation trials plus2 reactImpulse trials. 140 constraints per trial in normal,142 in boss; every row has16 numbers. No backtracking in this corpus. Across a call:1120–1420 copied rows,143360–181760 row bytes,183104–232304 total trial numeric bytes. Rows account for about78.3% of this logical payload. The baseline0 represents no trial API payload, NOT zero allocation.
interpretation.proposalOnly: Measured row payload warrants considering separate compact/full trial diagnostics: internal consumer needs summary complementarity, velocities, energy and W; explicit detailed trial callers/tests can retain owned rows. Reuse/compact design must preserve exact trial/application outputs and release policy. No implementation or optimization applied; these measurements do not attribute the observed timing increase specifically to copied rows.
